hook.en: In 1955, for the first time, ordinary people in Malaya chose who would govern them. One coalition won 51 out of 52 seats. What did that landslide tell the British?
hook.bm: Pada 1955, buat pertama kali, rakyat biasa di Tanah Melayu memilih siapa yang akan memerintah mereka. Satu gabungan memenangi 51 daripada 52 kerusi. Apakah mesej kemenangan besar itu kepada British?

bigIdeas.en: Elections let people choose leaders — a key feature of democracy.
bigIdeas.bm: Pilihan raya membolehkan rakyat memilih pemimpin — ciri utama demokrasi.

bigIdeas.en: Local elections started with George Town (1951) and Kuala Lumpur (1952).
bigIdeas.bm: Pilihan raya tempatan bermula di George Town (1951) dan Kuala Lumpur (1952).

bigIdeas.en: The first federal election (27 July 1955) gave the Alliance 51 of 52 seats and Tunku became Chief Minister.
bigIdeas.bm: Pilihan raya umum persekutuan pertama (27 Julai 1955) memberi Perikatan 51 daripada 52 kerusi dan Tunku menjadi Ketua Menteri.

cells.bm: Pilihan raya perbandaran pertama di Tanah Melayu

definition.en: Process where voters choose representatives by secret ballot.
definition.bm: Proses pengundi memilih wakil secara undi rahsia.

definition.en: Government by the people, usually through elected representatives.
definition.bm: Pemerintahan oleh rakyat, biasanya melalui wakil yang dipilih.

definition.en: A party's written promises to voters.
definition.bm: Janji bertulis sesebuah parti kepada pengundi.

definition.en: Leader of the elected government before independence — Tunku Abdul Rahman (1955).
definition.bm: Ketua kerajaan yang dipilih sebelum merdeka — Tunku Abdul Rahman (1955).

question.en: State TWO reasons the Alliance won the 1955 election. (2 marks)
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA sebab Perikatan menang pilihan raya 1955. (2 markah)

steps.en: Reason 1: inter-ethnic cooperation of UMNO, MCA and MIC.
steps.bm: Sebab 1: kerjasama antara kaum UMNO, MCA dan MIC.

steps.en: Reason 2: a manifesto promising independence within four years.
steps.bm: Sebab 2: manifesto menjanjikan kemerdekaan dalam masa empat tahun.

answer.en: "State" questions need short, precise points — no long explanations.
answer.bm: Soalan "nyatakan" memerlukan isi ringkas dan tepat — tiada huraian panjang.

prompt.en: The first municipal election in Malaya was held in…
prompt.bm: Pilihan raya perbandaran pertama di Tanah Melayu diadakan di…

explanation.en: George Town, Penang, held it in December 1951.
explanation.bm: George Town, Pulau Pinang, mengadakannya pada Disember 1951.

prompt.en: The first federal general election was held on…
prompt.bm: Pilihan raya umum persekutuan pertama diadakan pada…

explanation.bm: Rakyat Tanah Melayu mengundi pada 27 Julai 1955.

prompt.en: In 1955 the Alliance won ______ of the 52 seats.
prompt.bm: Pada 1955 Perikatan memenangi ______ daripada 52 kerusi.

explanation.en: Only one seat went to PAS.

prompt.en: After the 1955 election, Tunku Abdul Rahman became…
prompt.bm: Selepas pilihan raya 1955, Tunku Abdul Rahman menjadi…

explanation.en: He became Chief Minister and later the first Prime Minister.
explanation.bm: Beliau menjadi Ketua Menteri dan kemudian Perdana Menteri pertama.

prompt.en: Which party won the only non-Alliance seat in 1955?
prompt.bm: Parti manakah memenangi satu-satunya kerusi bukan Perikatan pada 1955?

explanation.en: PAS won the Krian seat in Perak.
explanation.bm: PAS memenangi kerusi Krian di Perak.

prompt.en: The first elections in Sarawak (district councils) were held in…
prompt.bm: Pilihan raya pertama di Sarawak (majlis daerah) diadakan pada…

explanation.en: Sarawak held district council elections in 1959.
explanation.bm: Sarawak mengadakan pilihan raya majlis daerah pada 1959.

prompt.en: A party's written promises to voters are called its ______.
prompt.bm: Janji bertulis parti kepada pengundi dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: The Alliance manifesto promised independence within four years.
explanation.bm: Manifesto Perikatan menjanjikan kemerdekaan dalam masa empat tahun.

prompt.en: Which coalition won the 1952 Kuala Lumpur municipal election?
prompt.bm: Gabungan manakah memenangi pilihan raya perbandaran Kuala Lumpur 1952?

prompt.en: Select ALL reasons for the Alliance's 1955 win.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA sebab kemenangan Perikatan pada 1955.

explanation.en: The PKM was a banned, armed group — it did not support the Alliance.
explanation.bm: PKM ialah kumpulan bersenjata yang diharamkan — tidak menyokong Perikatan.

prompt.en: What was the main promise in the Alliance manifesto?
prompt.bm: Apakah janji utama dalam manifesto Perikatan?

explanation.en: Its slogan focused on independence and unity.
explanation.bm: Slogannya memberi tumpuan kepada kemerdekaan dan perpaduan.

prompt.en: Why were municipal elections held before the federal election?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah pilihan raya perbandaran diadakan sebelum pilihan raya persekutuan?

explanation.en: Local elections were practice before national self-government.
explanation.bm: Pilihan raya tempatan ialah latihan sebelum pemerintahan sendiri peringkat kebangsaan.

options.en: To give people and parties experience of democracy step by step
options.bm: Memberi pengalaman demokrasi kepada rakyat dan parti secara berperingkat

prompt.en: Arrange the elections in time order.
prompt.bm: Susun pilihan raya mengikut kronologi.

prompt.en: Of the 98 seats in the Federal Legislative Council in 1955, how many were elected?
prompt.bm: Daripada 98 kerusi Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan pada 1955, berapakah yang dipilih?

explanation.en: 52 were elected; the rest were appointed.

prompt.en: Match each item with the 1955 election fact.
prompt.bm: Padankan perkara dengan fakta pilihan raya 1955.

explanation.en: These are the key facts of the first federal election.
explanation.bm: Inilah fakta penting pilihan raya persekutuan pertama.

prompt.en: Elections in Sabah started with local council elections in…
prompt.bm: Pilihan raya di Sabah bermula dengan pilihan raya majlis tempatan pada…

explanation.en: Sabah held its first local elections in 1962, just before Malaysia was formed.
explanation.bm: Sabah mengadakan pilihan raya tempatan pertama pada 1962, sebelum Malaysia dibentuk.

prompt.en: A secret ballot means…
prompt.bm: Undi rahsia bermaksud…

options.en: No one else knows whom you voted for
options.bm: Tiada orang lain tahu siapa yang anda undi

prompt.en: What did the 1955 result prove to the British?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang dibuktikan keputusan 1955 kepada British?

explanation.en: This strengthened Tunku's case in the London talks of 1956.
explanation.bm: Ini menguatkan hujah Tunku dalam rundingan London 1956.

options.en: The people trusted a united multiracial leadership ready to govern
options.bm: Rakyat mempercayai kepimpinan berbilang kaum yang bersatu dan bersedia memerintah

prompt.en: Why is voting a responsibility, not just a right, for citizens?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah mengundi satu tanggungjawab, bukan sekadar hak, bagi rakyat?

explanation.en: Democracy works only when citizens participate wisely.
explanation.bm: Demokrasi hanya berfungsi apabila rakyat terlibat dengan bijak.

options.en: Voters decide who leads the country, which affects everyone
options.bm: Pengundi menentukan siapa memimpin negara, yang memberi kesan kepada semua

prompt.en: Which BEST explains why Dato' Onn's new party failed in 1955 while the Alliance succeeded?
prompt.bm: Manakah PALING menjelaskan mengapa parti baharu Dato' Onn gagal pada 1955 sedangkan Perikatan berjaya?

explanation.en: Parti Negara failed to win any seat; voters trusted the Alliance network.
explanation.bm: Parti Negara gagal memenangi sebarang kerusi; pengundi mempercayai rangkaian Perikatan.

options.en: The Alliance had strong grassroots support in each community
options.bm: Perikatan mempunyai sokongan akar umbi yang kuat dalam setiap kaum

options.en: Onn was not allowed to stand

prompt.en: How did elections in Sabah and Sarawak relate to the formation of Malaysia?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah pilihan raya di Sabah dan Sarawak berkait dengan pembentukan Malaysia?

explanation.en: Early elections helped local leaders take part in the Malaysia negotiations.
explanation.bm: Pilihan raya awal membantu pemimpin tempatan terlibat dalam rundingan Malaysia.

options.en: They built political parties and awareness before joining Malaysia in 1963
options.bm: Ia membina parti politik dan kesedaran sebelum menyertai Malaysia pada 1963
